data.name: Atrophia: Diseased Lands
data.detailed_description:
Atrophia: Diseased Lands is a dark Celtic action RPG focused on skill-based combat, player-driven progression, and world-changing choices.

A ritual meant to protect a remote island has gone wrong. A living fog consumes the land, warps creatures, and drives people to desperation. As one of the few survivors, you fight through corrupted regions, uncover lost history, and decide what remains of this world.

What you can expect:

• Fast, precision-based melee combat

Time dodges, chain attacks, and exploit enemy weaknesses in real-time battles.

• Battle Dance combat mechanic

Maintain combat rhythm to unlock stronger abilities and keep pressure on enemies. Lose tempo and the fight becomes harder.

• Deep progression without traditional leveling

Improve core attributes directly to shape your build and combat style.

• Tactical ranged combat

Use a living quiver with different arrow types, each suited to specific enemies and situations.

• Choice-driven world state

Your decisions affect corruption levels, region outcomes, and who survives.

• Narrative Bestiary

Study the monsters you face to reveal hidden traits, tactical insights, and alternate ways to overcome encounters.

• Dynamic world corruption

The island changes over time: neglected areas decay further, while reclaimed zones can recover.

Fight through a collapsing land, master its systems, and decide whether this island is saved, abandoned, or consumed.
